title: A geometric flow associated to $Q$-curvature
summary: Branson's $Q$-curvature is a natural fourth-order counterpart of scalar curvature in conformal geometry. In analogy with the classical recovery of the Ricci tensor from the linearized scalar curvature, Lin and Yuan introduced a symmetric $2$-tensor $J_g$ through the formal adjoint of the linearized $Q$-curvature and established its explicit decomposition in terms of the Bach tensor and auxiliary curvature terms.
